title: AnalyseTool organization policy
description: policy.json — machine layer (%ProgramData%\AnalyseTool\policy.json) or organization layer (joined by URL). Every section is optional. See docs/enterprise-deployment-design.md.

policyUrl.description: Pointer form: the real policy lives at this https URL or file-system path. Followed from plugin phase 3a on.

enforced.description: Pointer form: the user cannot leave the organization.

downloadUrl.description: Where a seat below minimumVersion gets the installer.

locked.description: Settings the user may not change. A value present but not locked is only a default.

enabled.description: Allow ad-hoc C# execution (ExecuteRevitCode). Recommended: false + locked.

roots.description: Additional extension source folders (dev zone, not removable). %ENV% is expanded.

allowedFeeds.description: Prefix whitelist for install sources and update feeds: 'github:owner/' or 'https://host/path/'. Absent = everything allowed.

required.description: Extensions every seat must have. Phase 2.

allowInstallFromRepository.description: False refuses the free-form 'Install from repository…' paste; catalog entries still go through allowedFeeds.

enabled.description: Whether the in-Revit MCP bridge may run.
